selections.title: Blaster Bastards
selections.summary: A revived multiplayer bomb game with new artwork, music, and computer opponents. The creator describes a free Windows and Mac release rebuilt from their original source code.

selections.title: Bannerfall
selections.summary: Compete with three other players to claim resources and defeat a boss. This arcade shoot-out is part of the creator’s Fourfold collection; a larger screen is recommended.

selections.title: There Is Eternal War
selections.summary: Organize troops into divisions and assign buildings to supply them. Large maps support broad strategic decisions while players can zoom in to watch battles. A free Steam playtest is open.

selections.title: The Lost Colony
selections.summary: An isometric science-fiction action RPG in Unreal Engine. This progress post shows revised movement, hit reactions, enemy behavior, and combat feedback after an earlier round of player criticism.

selections.title: Lawncrest Mall
selections.summary: Explore an abandoned shopping mall in an anomaly horror game. The two-person development team has released a free Steam demo and is seeking feedback on clarity, atmosphere, and frustrating moments.

selections.title: MiniMachines: Steam to Singularities
selections.summary: Start with simple tools on an island and build an automated factory through successive technology tiers. The creator describes steam power, electrical networks, rockets, and multiple worlds in an actively developed free download.

selections.title: Zoo Pet
selections.summary: Grow crops, raise animals, decorate a home, and explore with other players. The solo developer’s browser world also includes character transformations and a server-wide boss encounter.

selections.title: KEEP ON RIDING
selections.summary: Ride from the Italian countryside toward the North Cape, managing fuel, traffic, and route choices. Unlock faster motorcycles as you progress in this free browser work in progress.

selections.title: Skyveil Horizon
selections.summary: Previously called Project Anime Glider, this multiplayer project mixes gliding, RPG progression, and arena-game ideas. The creator is preparing an online test and sharing recent gameplay changes.

selections.title: Merkalis: Conquest
selections.summary: A real-time strategy game with battlefield spells. The developer shares a spell demonstration and links a free Steam demo for players to test.

selections.title: EXO: Hold the Line
selections.summary: Pilot a war frame against large waves of machines in a voxel arena. The creator’s early alpha footage shows different Vanguard builds, with unfinished systems and bugs still being worked on.

selections.title: Plesen'
selections.summary: A work in progress combining digging, simplified factory automation, and combat. The creator is experimenting with the parts of mining and production games they most enjoy.

selections.title: Blood Slayers
selections.summary: A browser game shared with five acts available. The creator identifies a Rust-based implementation and links the playable build; the source provides little additional gameplay detail.

selections.title: NEON AFTERHOURS
selections.summary: An office worker escapes into action-film fantasies. Navigate lethal top-down encounters, stealth objectives, and hostage situations, then return home between films. The browser beta supports keyboard, mouse, and gamepad.

selections.title: Misty and the Last Breeze
selections.summary: Run, wall-run, and swing through compact stages, then summon an airboard to grind and perform tricks. The solo developer is refining movement and level design in Godot.

selections.title: RC Vibe GP
selections.summary: A radio-controlled racing project with local and online multiplayer experiments. The developer describes working courses, rival-car tuning, and additional modes including arena battles and capture the flag.

selections.title: Idle Freelance
selections.summary: An idle game returning with improvements after community feedback. The creator shares a free playable version and invites another round of player reactions.

selections.title: DOMDIVE
selections.summary: Descend through a hazardous vertical platformer as the difficulty rises. Share a level seed to challenge friends with the same layout. The browser game is free and needs no account.

selections.title: A Place Beyond
selections.summary: Explore a world based on the creator’s drawings, gather companions, and face bosses. This browser prototype includes boats, parkour, and bullet-hell encounters, with keyboard and gamepad support.

selections.title: HEATSINK
selections.summary: A drone racing game with a new map, revised drones, power-ups, and performance improvements. The creator is collecting feedback on what to add next.

selections.title: Smokestack
selections.summary: Guide an industrial business beginning in 1991. Decisions about contracts, quality, debt, and family compound over time as historical events change the conditions around the company.

selections.title: Idle Idiots
selections.summary: An incremental auto-battler with irreverent humor, unusual legendary equipment, achievements, and a snapshot-based PvP arena. The creator is inviting players to try the current browser build.

selections.title: Looks Legit
selections.summary: Paint inexpensive imitations that fool deliberately limited automated art appraisers. Learn what each model can perceive, then exploit its blind spots. Browser and desktop versions are available.

selections.title: Grayfall
selections.summary: The creator tests an early level on a handheld device and shares unedited gameplay. The project is still in development, with feedback sought on the current atmosphere and feel.

selections.title: Parallax Runner
selections.summary: Run across rainy rooftops while other players race in parallel lanes. A pursuing drone retraces your route, and markers show where earlier runners failed. No signup is required.

selections.title: Somnaworld
selections.summary: Explore, build, and survive by day, then make dream choices that alter the waking world. The first public alpha includes combat, dungeons, and persistent changes to the landscape.

selections.title: NIGHT SHIFT
selections.summary: Work a night shift with friends, complete tasks, and hide from a creature stalking the store. The creator shares a free browser build through a project showcase page.

selections.title: Hearsay
selections.summary: Reassemble fragments of historical recordings by listening and arranging tapes. This first-person puzzle project uses archival audio, with a Steam demo planned but not yet announced as available in the source post.

selections.title: TIBERAVA
selections.summary: An early strategy project combining city-building, large battles, and roguelite influences. The creator shares a playable alpha and recommends desktop for the best experience.

selections.title: Lanterns of Aldermere
selections.summary: A village lantern has gone dark and its keeper is missing. Follow two heroes into forests and ruins in the playable first chapter of a turn-based pixel-art RPG.

selections.title: Iron Vigil
selections.summary: A side-scrolling survivor game designed for Game Boy Advance hardware and emulators. The creator shares a demoable work in progress with generated artwork and music.
